flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No SPMS or season parking code in the six repos. Nearby: thirdpartyapi only has CES/AXS webhooks (workflows/cesTpApiARelay, workflows/axsNopo); ocmsadminprivateapi AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl only handles MHA, LTA, TOPPAN.
note: Story status is blank in stories.json; assessed from the story text. Grep for SPMS, season parking, season park, parking pass across the six repos finds nothing. There is no selection of tagged IDs with outstanding fines, no processing stage/ID type criteria, no file for SPMS, and no delivery to SPMS. thirdpartyapi only holds the CES and AXS webhooks (inbound). The agency types in AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-87 are only MHA, LTA, TOPPAN. The step where SPMS asks the customer to settle fines happens on the SPMS side and cannot be assessed from the repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. The feature that sends tagged IDs to SPMS is not built

steps.step: OCMS selects IDs tagged by URA for season parking services that have outstanding fines
steps.detail: There is no season parking tagging query, table, or flag. Grep for SPMS and season parking finds nothing in the six repos. There is no tagging/hitlist entity, repository, service, or screen in the six repos (grep for hitlist, tagging, tagged, SPMS, season parking returns nothing in source). The only leftovers are the commented-out 'Tagged Vehicle' route and menu (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:326-329; ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:406; ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/TaggedVehicle.ts:1-12) and a translation label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:167-169).

steps.step: OCMS applies the pre-defined criteria (processing stage, ID type)
steps.detail: There is no criteria configuration or filter for SPMS. Processing stage and ID type exist in the notice data, but no rule uses them to select season parking IDs.

steps.step: OCMS generates the tagged-ID file for SPMS
steps.detail: There is no SPMS file builder. createRequestFileContent handles only MHA, LTA, TOPPAN and throws UnsupportedOperationException for other types (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-87); there is no SPMS cron in cron-schedules-prod.properties.

steps.step: OCMS sends the file to SPMS
steps.detail: There is no SFTP, API client, or endpoint to SPMS. thirdpartyapi only holds inbound CES and AXS webhooks, and the prod sftp.upload.allowedSources lists only COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_LTA and COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_CES (application-prod.properties:83). The SPMS follow-up asking the customer to settle fines is on the SPMS side and cannot be verified from the repo.
